ratings_why.fun: Every turn is a scouted vote with payoffs on both sides, and Stretch-Holder, Almoner and the Diving coots pull your board's shape in opposite directions; happily drafted, though the Lower side carries most of the engine.
ratings_why.distinct: Earns 8 over 7 because one waterline acts on both boards and cares about unit shape, so the same Raise sinks their Eggs and your own coots on purpose; no tribe today plays like that.

verdict_why: One real reading gap (Kees Kowk against a Diving enemy) is worth a line; the rest would only make it different.

points.text: Kees Kowk targets a random Under enemy, but Dive says enemies attack it only if they have no other target. Say which wins when the only Under enemies Dive.
Lower pays gold, stats and even water (Keeper of the Overflow), while Raise pays mostly stats. Give High Water one payoff only a positive Level can buy, so the vote stays a real choice.
Gauge-Keeper reading its own Health makes Schouw-Walker, Almoner and Stretch-Holder feed the water itself. Great hidden loop; name it in a build so players find it.
Almoner against Stretch-Holder is the best decision in the tribe: who stands beside the Holder each turn. A second card that rewards a unit staying low would deepen it.
Keeper of the Overflow dying mid-fight surfaces both boards at once, which can save the enemy's units. A fun swing; let Rafting Coot or Winter Raft care about units surfacing too.

standouts.why: Grows the water from its own Health, so every Health buffer in the tribe becomes a Flood buffer.
The board's spine: lifts neighbours above the water but out of Almoner's reach, so placement is a real puzzle.
Turns Lowering into fight water, the bridge that makes Drain and Flood one build with a killable weak point.

weakest.why: Gold per Lower, three times a turn; it does one obvious job and touches nothing else.
A plain vote-or-gold seed with no overlap beyond feeding the Vote count.
Grows only Health from Votes; a filler Vote source.

flags.note: With a fed Gauge-Keeper, Tiddy Mun's half-the-water line can drown most enemies at Start of Combat; tall boards are the only answer.
With Hendrika and Sluiswacht, Drain gold stacks into uncapped carry-over for triple chains.
Targeting an Under enemy that Dives is not settled by either text.
